blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY— The Romblon provincial government is studying the distribution of drought-tolerant crops to farmers as it prepares to cushion farmers from a “Super El Niño.” The Provincial Agriculture Office would hold technical meetings in each municipality to discuss preparations and provide farmers with information on the possible effects of El Niño, according to the Philippine Information Agency in Mimaropa (Mindoro Occidental and Oriental, Marinduque, Romblon, and Palawan.) READ: Puerto Princesa eyes cloud seeding amid ‘Super El Niño’ Among the measures is the distribution of mung bean (monggo) and corn seeds from the Department of Agriculture (DA) for planting after farmers harvest their rice.
